requirements.evidence: Contract largely met: Queues.php has all listed properties/methods and passes accessQueue/accessGrants scoped via $this->entity->queues()->find() (Queues.php:271-285); rename re-derives slug with Str::slug (Queues.php:197); confirmation modal instead of wire:confirm (queues.blade.php:665-684); Serve.callNext handles null selection, Inactive/NoWaiting exceptions, rate-limit on success (Serve.php:359-391); Members tabs with setActiveTab whitelist (Members.php:30-37); routes and navbar added. Gaps: invalid client-set `mode` makes CallMode::from throw a ValueError (Serve.php:376); mode selector options are hardcoded English 'any/priority_only/normal_only' and labelled with ui.members_role (serve.blade.php:756-761); queues empty state reuses ui.serve_empty 'No tickets waiting' (queues.blade.php:597); priority column shown as raw number.

conventions.evidence: No tests at all despite 'No production code without a test'. Livewire inputs `name`, `renameName`, `mode`, `activeTab` have no #[Validate] (Queues.php:72,95; Serve.php:324; Members.php:21), relying only on domain validation. Positives: domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket; CHANGELOG updated (CHANGELOG.md:9); sibling Bulma row/modal style matched. Hardcoded UI text in serve.blade.php:758-761 breaks 'all text from lang'.

security.evidence: All client ids resolved scoped: findOrFail via $this->entity->queues()/memberships() in openQueue, startRename, rename, confirmToggle, toggleActive, grant/revokeAccess, callNext; entity and lastCalledTicketId are #[Locked]; render hides tickets unless Gate allows call (Serve.php:402-418); output escaped with {{ }}. Gaps of limited impact: rename/toggleActive/grantAccess/revokeAccess do not call $this->authorize in the component (rely on authorization inside actions, Queues.php:188-267); `mode` unvalidated -> 500; public helper callableQueues() exposed as a callable endpoint contrary to rule 5 (Serve.php:345).

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files: no feature tests for Queues/Serve components, routes, members tabs, nor the required unauthorized-call and tamper tests per action.

simplicity.evidence: Direct implementation reusing domain actions and existing x-label/x-input components. Some redundancy: closeQueue calls reset() then reassigns the same properties (Queues.php:160-166); create() resets then sets name='' again (Queues.php:139-140); $queue->fresh() after fresh findOrFail (Queues.php:232); unused 'lastCalled' view data (Serve.php:420-428); duplicated ValidationException-to-error loop in create/rename.

readability.evidence: Clear names and docblocks on untrusted properties, consistent with Members.php. Dead/redundant code noted above; duplicate role="tablist" on both div and ul (members.blade.php:537-538); misleading labels (ui.members_role for mode, aria-label="mode").

scope.evidence: Every changed file (Members tabs, Queues/Serve components and views, lang keys, navbar, routes, CHANGELOG) serves the task; no unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: No Pest tests ship with two new Livewire components, routes and the members tabs, violating the mandatory TDD rule and the Livewire definition of done (unauthorized-call and tamper tests per action).
Client-writable inputs `name`, `renameName` and `mode` lack #[Validate] + $this->validate(), contrary to the project's Livewire validation pattern.
`mode` is client-writable and unvalidated, so a tampered value makes CallMode::from throw a ValueError (500) instead of a validation error.

rename, toggleActive, grantAccess and revokeAccess do not call $this->authorize() in the component, relying solely on authorization inside the actions, while the policy says every public action authorizes server-side.
Helper callableQueues() is public and therefore callable from the client; it should be protected/private (or a #[Computed]).
Mode selector uses hardcoded English option labels and the unrelated ui.members_role label instead of lang strings.
Empty queue list shows ui.serve_empty ('No tickets waiting'), the wrong message.
Redundant reassignments after reset() and an unnecessary ->fresh().
`lastCalled` is queried and passed to the view but never used.
role="tablist" is set on both the wrapper div and the ul.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues management page, the Serve panel, members tabs, navbar entries, routes and lang keys, correctly scoping every client id to the entity and routing writes through the domain actions. However, it ships no tests at all (a blocker under the project's TDD and Livewire policy), leaves Livewire inputs without #[Validate] (an invalid mode causes a 500), and has some hardcoded or wrong UI strings, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
